value.rationale: The question of maximizing the probability that both invasive taxa are detected is distinct from maximizing a single taxon or expected taxa detected. The result classifies all positive parameter choices with a sharp finite-concentration boundary, identifies the monotone change in preferred monitoring season, shows no multi-season gain under collinear independent hazards, and gives small- and large-effort asymptotics that clarify when compromise remains unavoidable. Ecological relevance is restricted to the assumed calibrated hazard class.
